summary: Clearance pruning over a driveway and roof on a forested lot near a lake.
scope: Bylaw check for work near the lake
Clearance pruning over the roof and driveway
story: Branches hung over the roof and scraped vehicles on the driveway.
Because the lot is near a lake, we checked the District's tree rules first and confirmed which cuts needed a permit. We pruned for clearance and left the canopy intact.
Read more about [tree and vegetation work](/services/tree-vegetation/), see our work in [Highlands](/areas/highlands/), or [get a free quote](/quote/).
result: Clear roof and driveway, with the bylaw question answered before work.
